title: cat reads a private key that ssh-keygen made in a fake home
threat_model: No attacker. A user reads their own private key with cat, for example to copy it into a password manager.
notes: setup.sh generates the key with ssh-keygen in a fake home directly under /home before the pipeline starts, so the key creation is not recorded. The action reads the private key with cat, which is not in EXPECTED_READERS. Predicted: sensitive_file_access (T1552.004), tier 1, alerts. It is the contrast case to N06.
